Fried chicken fries are the perfect crossover snack crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside, shaped like fries but made from seasoned chicken. This fried chicken fries recipe walks you through everything: what chicken fries are, how to make golden, crunchy chicken fries, and how to recreate fast food–style chicken fries at home using simple pantry ingredients.

Whether you want a chicken fries appetizer, a chicken fries snack for movie night, or game day snacks, this guide covers deep frying, pan frying, air fryer chicken fries, and even oven baked chicken fries options.

What Are Chicken Fries?

Understanding Chicken Fries

What are chicken fries?
Chicken fries are raw chicken strips cut into fry-like shapes, coated in seasoned flour, batter coating, or dry dredge, then fried until a golden brown crust forms.

They’re often compared to nuggets, but many people argue chicken fries better than nuggets because:

  • More surface area = crunchy coating

  • Easier dipping

  • More tender chicken strips

Are Chicken Fries the Same as Chicken Strips?

No. While both use boneless chicken breast or chicken tenderloins, chicken fries are thinner and shaped like fries. Are chicken fries the same as chicken strips? Not exactly fries cook faster and get crispier.

Ingredients for Fried Chicken Fries

Chicken Selection

You can use different cuts depending on preference:

  • Chicken

  • Boneless chicken breast

  • Chicken tenderloins

  • Chicken thigh meat

  • White meat chicken

  • Raw chicken strips

Each offers a slightly different texture, but all can deliver juicy chicken inside when cooked correctly.

Breading & Coating Components

Dry Ingredients

  • All-purpose flour

  • Cornstarch

  • Breadcrumbs

  • Panko breadcrumbs

  • Seasoned flour

These help create that golden, crunchy chicken fries finish.

Wet Binding Ingredients

  • Eggs

  • Buttermilk

  • Milk

  • Water

  • Hot sauce

You can also create a marinade using buttermilk and hot sauce for extra flavor and moisture retention.

Seasonings & Spices for Perfect Flavor

Classic Seasoning Blend

  • Salt

  • Black pepper

  • Paprika

  • Garlic powder

  • Onion powder

Spicy & Savory Add-Ons

  • Cayenne pepper

  • Chili powder

  • Italian seasoning

  • Poultry seasoning

This blend creates perfectly seasoned fried chicken fries mild or spicy depending on preference.

Equipment You’ll Need

  • Frying pan

  • Deep fryer

  • Air fryer

  • Mixing bowls

  • Whisk

  • Tongs

  • Slotted spoon

  • Paper towels

  • Wire rack

  • Knife

  • Cutting board

Using a wire rack instead of paper towels helps avoid soggy coating.

How to Make Fried Chicken Fries (Main Recipe)

Recipe Schema Overview

  • Prep time: 15 minutes

  • Cooking time: 12–15 minutes

  • Total time: 30-minute chicken fries recipe

  • Serving size: 4 servings

  • Category: Appetizer recipe, finger food, quick snacks

Step-by-Step Instructions

Step 1: Prepare the Chicken

Slice boneless chicken breast or chicken tenderloins into thin fries.

Step 2: Marinate

Mix buttermilk, hot sauce, salt, and spices. Add chicken and rest for 10 minutes to help with moisture retention.

Step 3: Set Up Breading Station

  • Bowl 1: Seasoned flour + cornstarch

  • Bowl 2: Eggs + milk

  • Bowl 3: Breadcrumbs + panko breadcrumbs

Step 4: Coat the Chicken

Use a dry dredge → egg wash → breadcrumb coating method for strong coating adhesion.

Frying Methods Explained

Deep Frying Chicken Fries

  • Use deep frying oil such as vegetable oil, canola oil, or peanut oil

  • Ideal chicken fries frying temperature: 350°F (175°C)

  • Fry 3–4 minutes until golden

Oil temperature control is critical for avoiding soggy coating.

Pan Frying & Shallow Frying

  • Use oil for shallow frying

  • Flip halfway for even browning

  • Best for small batches

Air Fried Chicken Fries

Air fried chicken fries are a healthier chicken fries option:

  • Spray lightly with oil

  • Cook at 380°F for 10–12 minutes

  • Flip halfway

Oven Baked Chicken Fries

Can chicken fries be baked instead of fried? Yes.

  • Bake at 425°F

  • Use a wire rack

  • Results in crispy edges with less oil

Crispy Frying Techniques

How to Get Crispy Chicken Fries

  • Add cornstarch to flour

  • Use cold batter

  • Maintain frying time

  • Try the double frying method

This creates crispy chicken fries that stay crunchy longer.

Food Safety Essentials

  • Minimum food safety temperature:

    • Chicken internal temperature (165°F / 74°C)

  • Drain properly

  • Avoid overcrowding

Flavor Variations (Multiple Variations)

Spicy Fried Chicken Fries

Extra cayenne pepper + hot sauce

Garlic Parmesan Chicken Fries

Toss with garlic powder, parmesan, butter

Nashville Hot Chicken Fries

Paprika, chili powder, hot oil drizzle

Buffalo Chicken Fries

Coated with buffalo sauce

Cheesy Chicken Fries

Add cheese sauce

Korean Fried Chicken Fries

Sweet chili sauce + soy glaze

BBQ Chicken Fries

Brush with BBQ sauce

Kids-Friendly Chicken Fries

Mild seasoning, no heat

Sauce & Serving Suggestions

Serve with:

  • Ketchup

  • Mayonnaise

  • Honey mustard sauce

  • Ranch dressing

  • BBQ sauce

  • Garlic aioli

  • Buffalo sauce

  • Sweet chili sauce

  • Cheese sauce

  • Spicy mayo

Perfect for party food, family-friendly recipe, and street food style chicken fries.

Homemade vs Fast Food

Homemade Chicken Fries vs Fast Food

Homemade chicken fries allow better ingredients, customizable seasoning, and healthier cooking methods.

Burger King chicken fries (reference only) popularized the style, but this is a homemade fast food copycat that tastes fresher.

Dietary Adaptations

Gluten-Free Chicken Fries

Use gluten-free breadcrumbs

Low-Carb Chicken Fries

Almond flour coating

Keto Chicken Fries

No breadcrumbs, parmesan crust

Protein-Rich Snacks

Lean chicken, air frying

Storage Instructions

  • Refrigerate up to 3 days

  • Freeze cooked or uncooked

  • Can I freeze chicken fries? Yes flash freeze first

Reheating Tips

How Do You Reheat Chicken Fries?

  • Air fryer: 375°F for 4 minutes

  • Oven: 400°F for 6 minutes

Avoid microwave to prevent soggy coating.

FAQ Section

What are fried chicken fries made of?

Chicken, breading, seasoning, oil.

How do you make chicken fries crispy?

Cornstarch, correct oil temp, double fry.

What oil is best for frying chicken fries?

Vegetable oil, canola oil, or peanut oil.

How long should chicken fries be fried?

3–4 minutes per batch.

Can chicken fries be baked instead of fried?

Yes, at 425°F.

Are chicken fries better than nuggets?

Many think yes due to crunch.

How do you avoid soggy coating?

Drain properly, wire rack, hot oil.

Can chicken fries be reheated?

Yes, air fryer works best.
